Startup Raises $100M for Enterprise AI Platform

August 10, 2026

A San Francisco-based artificial intelligence startup has raised $100 million in Series B funding to expand its enterprise AI platform that helps companies automate complex business processes using large language models.

The round was led by prominent venture capital firms, valuing the company at $1.2 billion. The startup's platform enables organizations to deploy custom AI models for tasks ranging from document analysis to customer service automation.

Founded in 2024, the company has grown rapidly, now serving over 200 enterprise customers including several Fortune 500 companies. The new funding will be used to expand the engineering team and accelerate product development.

"We're seeing unprecedented demand for enterprise AI solutions that are both powerful and easy to deploy," said the company's CEO. "This funding will help us meet that demand and continue pushing the boundaries of what's possible with AI in the enterprise."

Industry analysts note that the enterprise AI market is expected to reach $150 billion by 2028, driven by advances in large language models and increasing adoption across industries.
